# Zephyr Client 1.2.0.26.2

7 new modules, plus new fake players, a notebook, structure copy/paste, ~26 new chat commands, smoother visuals, and big combat reliability fixes. This will likely be the last release for 26.2, since I'll be mainly on 26.3 for now.

## 1. New modules

### Pathing
Walks you to a spot or to the nearest block of a type, with an on-screen route.

- `.z path <x> <y> <z>`: walk to coordinates
- `.z path <x> <y> <z> destructive`: walk there while mining through and bridging over gaps
- `.z path task mine <block>`: find the nearest matching block and walk to + mine it
- `.z path stop`: cancel

### PearlCatch
Throws a wind charge right after you throw an ender pearl.

Settings: `Legit` (adds a human-like jitter), `Delay` (0–20 ticks).

### Mouse Tweaks
Makes chests and inventories much faster to move items in.

### AnchorHelper
Automates using anchors (requires you to place one down)

### CrystalHelper
Hold right-click while looking at a crystal support blocks and it locks to your crystal slot and loops place and break on that block.

### Disable Modules
Two new toggle modules under Disable:

- **Disable Fire Rendering**: hides world fire, soul fire, and flames on burning entities. First-person overlay is still covered by `disableFirstPersonFire`.
- **Disable Explosion Particles**: hides `EXPLOSION`, `EXPLOSION_EMITTER`, `POOF`, and `SMOKE`.

## 2. New tools

### Fake players (singleplayer only)
Spawn test players / bots for testing farms, combat, or redstone.

- `.z player <name> spawn [at <x> <y> <z>] [facing <yaw> <pitch>] [in <gamemode>] [in <dimension>]`
- `.z player <name> kill | stop | sneak | unsneak | sprint | unsprint | shadow | list`
- `.z player <name> use | attack | jump [once | continuous | interval]`
- `.z player <name> look | turn | move | hotbar | drop | dropStack | mount | dismount`

Fake players leave automatically when you disconnect.

### Notebook
A vanilla book-like editor for personal notes. Stored locally only, never sent to the server.

- `.z notebook`: open
- `.z notebook clear`: wipe

### Cornerstone
Select a region, save it, and paste it elsewhere with `setblock`/`fill` commands.

- `.z cornerstone select`: click two corners
- `.z cornerstone pos1/pos2 <x> <y> <z>`: set corners manually (relative works)
- `.z cornerstone save <name> [air]`: save selection
- `.z cornerstone run <name> [here | at <x> <y> <z>]`: paste it
- `.z cornerstone list`: show saves with size + command count
- `.z cornerstone delete <name>` / `clear` / `cancel`: manage / stop

### More client commands (ClientCommands port)
`.z` now has `c`-prefixed aliases too (`.z give` ≡ `.z cgive`), full tab-completion, and custom aliases via `.z alias`.

| Command | What it does |
|---------|--------------|
| `alias` | `add <key> <command>`, `list`, `remove`, `exec`: custom shortcuts with `%` placeholders |
| `config` | `list`, `get`, `set`: view/change settings including `TestMode` |
| `creativetab` | `add` / `remove` / `modify` custom creative tabs |
| `find` | Find nearby entities by type/name |
| `findblock` | Find a nearby block |
| `give` | `give <item> [count]` (creative) |
| `ghostblock` | `set` / `fill` client-side-only blocks |
| `getdata` | `entity <uuid>` / `block <x> <y> <z>` NBT data |
| `glow` | Highlight `entities`, `block`, or `area` for a duration |
| `hotbar` | `save` / `restore <1-9>` |
| `kit` | `create` / `delete` / `edit` / `load` / `list` / `preview`: kits now include armor, offhand, body/saddle |
| `look` | `block`, `angles`, `cardinal` direction info |
| `gamemode` | `query <player>`, `list <gamemode>` |
| `permissionlevel` | Show your permission level |
| `ping` | `ping [player]` |
| `pos` | `pos [to/from <dimension>]` with nether-coordinate conversion |
| `relog` | Rejoin the current server |
| `tp` | `tp <player\|uuid>` (spectator) |
| `time` | `query` / `set` / `reset` (client-side) |
| `uuid` | `uuid <player\|uuid>` lookup |

## Zephyr Client v1.1.2.26.2

1.1.2 adds ten new modules across three categories, a search box in the Keybinds screen, and generic text toasts for module events. The module count is now **85**.

### New modules (10)

#### Movement (5)

| Module     | Description                                        |
|------------|----------------------------------------------------|
| Auto Walk  | Walks forward automatically without holding W      |
| Blink      | Suppresses your position packets while enabled     |
| Ice Speed  | Stops you from sliding uncontrollably on ice       |
| Jesus      | Lets you walk on water as if it were solid ground  |
| Scaffold   | Places a block under your feet while you walk      |

#### Disable (1)

| Module                | Description                                       |
|-----------------------|---------------------------------------------------|
| Disable Damage Tilt   | Removes the camera tilt when you take damage      |

#### Combat (4)

| Module             | Description                                                      |
|--------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------|
| Auto Crystal       | Places and detonates end crystals on a target's obsidian support |
| Spear Damage       | Spoofs speed for massive spear stabs without moving              |
| Target Strafe      | Orbits around a nearby target while you move                     |
| Totem Pop Notifier | Notifies you when nearby players pop their totems                |

#### Auto Crystal

Auto Crystal places an obsidian support next to the target when one is missing, then an end crystal on top of it and detonates it once the target is in the blast. A configurable action delay paces the place/place/detonate sequence so the server registers each step, an **Avoid Self Damage** setting holds back the detonation when you would take more of the blast than the target, and **Players Only** restricts it to player targets. It honors the Reach module for both block and entity interaction ranges.

#### Spear Damage

While a spear is charging, Spear Damage sends a blink of two spoofed position packets each tick, jumping the server-side player a configurable number of blocks behind the look direction and back again. The last packet the server processes sets a large forward movement delta, and the KineticWeapon stab damage scales with that measured speed, producing huge hits while the local player never actually moves. The damage window only opens after the weapon's own delay ticks have elapsed.

#### Target Strafe

Target Strafe circles the nearest eligible target while you move: a KeyboardInput mixin turns the player toward the target and redirects your movement input into a left/right strafe, so you keep orbiting instead of running straight at it. **Players Only** limits it to players, **Only While Attacking** restricts strafing to when the attack key is held, and **Orbit Direction** picks clockwise or counter-clockwise.

#### Totem Pop Notifier

Totem Pop Notifier watches for nearby players popping their totem of undying and reports each pop with a running per-player total, through any combination of a **Chat Message**, a **Toast**, and a **HUD Counter** at the top of the screen. Tracking resets when the module is turned off.

### Changes

- **The Keybinds screen gained a search box** to filter modules by name or category.
- **Notifications can now be generic text toasts.** Besides the module hotkey ON/OFF toasts, modules can push plain message toasts with their own accent color (independent of the Hotkey Popups setting, but still hidden in Stealth Mode); Totem Pop Notifier uses them for pops.
- **Internal:** registered mixins backing the ten new modules (movement input/packet/friction/fluid handling, `GameRenderer` hurt-bob cancel, entity-event detection and a HUD counter for totem pops), and the toast renderer was refactored around a shared `Toast` interface.

## Zephyr Client v1.1.0.26.2

**This is a large update.** Three new QoL modules, including the first-ever module ports for 26.2 (Jade and ShulkerBoxTooltip), plus an inventory renderer. But more importantly, this release marks the client as **done**: beyond adding new modules as things come out, there is nothing left on the roadmap. That's why this is **1.1.0** and not 1.0.5. The module count is now **75**.

### New modules (3)

All three are QoL modules.

| Module | Description |
| --- | --- |
| Jade | A Jade/WTHIT-style overlay showing details about the block or entity you're looking at |
| InventoryRenderer | Shows your whole inventory on the HUD, with an optional armor and offhand column |
| ShulkerBoxTooltip | Shows the contents of shulker boxes and other containers inside their item tooltip |

#### Jade

Jade is a from-scratch recreation of Jade/WTHIT for 26.2. Every tick it ray-casts toward the block or entity under your crosshair, gathers details from registered providers into a tooltip, and renders it as a positioned, animated box that fades away when you look away instead of popping. The overlay's position is fully configurable (`TOP_LEFT` / `TOP_CENTER` / `TOP_RIGHT` / `CENTER` / `BOTTOM_LEFT` / `BOTTOM_CENTER` / `BOTTOM_RIGHT`), with independent **X/Y Offset**, **Extended Reach** (up to +5 blocks), **Fade Animation**, and **Overlay Alpha** settings. Content providers cover block states, crop growth progress, redstone signals, TNT stability, beehive honey level, mob health and armor, horse stats, and item frames, each individually toggleable.

#### InventoryRenderer

Draws a live preview of your entire inventory on the HUD — all 36 storage slots plus optional **armor** and **offhand** columns. It can be anchored to any of four screen corners (**Placement**: `BOTTOM_LEFT` / `BOTTOM_RIGHT` / `MIDDLE_LEFT` / `MIDDLE_RIGHT`), and per-column toggles (**Show Hotbar**, **Show Armor**, **Show Offhand**) let you trim it down to just what you want. Item counts and durability render on each stack, the selected hotbar slot is outlined, and a translucent **Background** can be toggled.

#### ShulkerBoxTooltip

A port of the Fabric mod ShulkerBoxTooltip. While enabled, hovering any supported container item renders a preview of its contents right inside the tooltip — no need to open it. Supported containers include **Shulker Boxes** (all dyes), **Chests** (including trapped, copper, and ender variants), **Barrels**, **Furnaces**, **Droppers**, **Dispensers**, **Hoppers**, **Brewing Stands**, **Decorated Pots**, **Chiseled Bookshelves**, and **Shelves**. **Preview Mode** switches between a `FULL` slot grid and a `COMPACT` merged view of identical stacks; **Tooltip Type** picks between the custom colored window (`MOD`) and a vanilla-style bundle grid (`VANILLA`); **Use Box Colors** tints the window by the container's dye color, with a dedicated Zephyr texture. Hovering an individual slot inside the preview shows that item's own tooltip.

### Changes

- **Internal:** the ShulkerBoxTooltip port hooks into the tooltip pipeline through new `GuiGraphics` mixins and a `PreviewTooltipComponent -> PreviewClientTooltipComponent` conversion registered in `ZephyrClient`, and Jade is driven by a dedicated `JadeRenderer` + `ProviderRegistry` + `RayTracer` under `qol.jade`. The leftover MobESP mixin was cleaned up.
